verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Circle publishes an API reference section and per-product OpenAPI YAML specs, such as compliance, gateway and CCTP. None of it documents an interactive explorer, an in-browser 'try it' console or runnable examples. A static reference and specs are building blocks, not the interactive capability the story asks for, and the probe found no top-level OpenAPI JSON either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
